findings.message: "#water" has CSS `transform: translateY(1920px)` and a GSAP tween animates y. GSAP will overwrite the full CSS transform, discarding any translateX(-50%) centering or CSS scale value.
findings.fixHint: Remove `transform: translateY(1920px)` from CSS and replace with GSAP properties: y: 1920. Example: tl.fromTo('#water', { y: 1920 }, { y: 1920, ...yourAnimation }). tl.fromTo is exempt from this rule.

findings.message: <div id="s1"> is a timeline element that contains nested <div>. The timeline shows one row per top-level element, and the root composition is built only from sub-compositions.
findings.fixHint: Move <div id="s1"> and its contents into a sub-composition file and mount it with data-composition-src.
